blocks.html: All signs shall bear a decal bearing the UL Classification Mark or name of the testing entity and its listing number on a corner of the face of the fabric. This decal shall be of color(s) contrasting with those of the background of the display, and shall be readable from street or roadway level with the aid of binoculars.
